exposure: Treatment group (isthmic circumferential suture vs. Bakri balloon tamponade)
cohort: 30 women who developed uterine atony during cesarean section, divided into two groups based on treatment received.
finding: Both isthmic circumferential suture and Bakri balloon tamponade were effective in treating uterine atony during cesarean section, but the former was associated with shorter operative time and less pre-operative blood loss.
